title: Add referenced named arguments
problem: Resolve human-readable field names while retaining typed value references.
design: Name lookup is runtime; wrappers do not allocate or own their referents.
tradeoffs:
`ffmt::arg(name, value)` stores a name view and a value reference. The name
characters and value must outlive use of the wrapper; temporary values remain
valid through the formatting expression. Names and named width/precision fields
are resolved at runtime. Literal parsing checks structural syntax, but cannot
fully validate a named field's type/specification because names are runtime data.
Use checked results to observe unresolved names or incompatible specifications.

source_provenance.source_changes: Borrowing/lifetime comments and conventional header layout; decomposed named tests plus direct missing-name, incompatible-spec and invalid-width status regressions. No implementation token change.

before: A checked core call with {value:04x} has no name wrapper to bind value; use positional indices instead.

validation.results: Pending validation of the assembled intermediate commit; root records exact commands and outcomes.
